run_interactive_translation: run the fairseq interactive CLI to translate raw text with a trained model using batched inference
run_buffered_read: run buffered_read to read lines from a file in fixed-size batches for on-the-fly batching
run_make_batches: run make_batches to encode source strings into tokenized batches for model inference
run_main_inference: run the main function to load models, build a generator, and perform interactive translation inference
run_cli_main: run cli_main to parse interactive generation arguments and launch distributed translation inference
